GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-06-05T12:35:17Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: RxJava 2.1.0 SerialDisposable#isDisposed() return false for Disposables#disposed() initial value
Description: Consider following code:
```java
SerialDisposable disposable = new SerialDisposable(Disposables.disposed());
if (disposable.isDisposed()) {
   // do somesing
}
```
I wanted to set my initial value to be disposed and thought ```isDispossed()``` will return ```true``` for ```Disposable``` returned from ```Disposables.disposed()```, but it actually returns ```false```. Find out thats because ```SerialDisposable#isDisposed()``` just check if current ```Disposable``` equals to ```DisposableHelper#DISPOSED```, which is weird. So to fix this I have to go with this:
```java
SerialDisposable disposable = new SerialDisposable(DisposableHelper.DISPOSED);
if (disposable.isDisposed()) {
   // do somesing
}
```
Is this intended behavior? If so, can you please explicitly indicate this in the documentation?
